nodes.label: Reads Never Mutate Truth Files
nodes.rationale: Usage signals land in the index access log only and settle into frontmatter through Manage in batch, so reads cause no truth churn.

nodes.label: Injection, Recall and Context Tracks
nodes.rationale: Injection carries a byte-prefix never a summary so truncation cannot cut a line, Recall ranks by relevance weight and recency with no model, and Context opens top entries in one call; scope filters before candidate limits.
